analyses.content: 录音中Jen明确提到Irene过去一周几乎都住在实验室里（living in the lab），直接对应选项C“在实验室花了大量时间”。
你可能会听到实验（experiment）就想选A，但录音说的是实验即将完成（just about done）而不是完成了种植，注意不要听到部分原词就着急选。
Have you heard anything from Irene? Yeah. Irene told me the experiment is just about done. She's been practically living in the lab the past week.

你听到前文的“style”一词可能会联想到选项B，但录音里“not her style”的意思是实验室工作不是她的行事风格，并不是说她打扮时尚。

Has Kim been helping her? I thought that lab work was not her style. Well, not so much in the lab, but she has started compiling the data for the analysis. Kim is terrific. I hate doing stats. I've always been bad at math.

Anyway, Kim hasn't actually run the stats for the project yet since she still has to wait for the rest of the experiment data. But she's ready to get started when we get the experiment done. Seriously, without Irene and Kim, we'd be in trouble.

你可能会被Jen后面开玩笑反问的“难道不是因为我受欢迎吗（popular）”干扰，做题时要认准别人给出拉她入伙的真实理由，而不是顺着玩笑话选。

Jen, you know we all depend on you for that. You're the only person I know that reads every assignment from beginning to end. You and Professor Cooper often have private discussions about readings in the middle of class. But hey, I'm not complaining. That's why all the rest of us asked you to be on our team. Oh, so that's why. So it wasn't because I'm popular, huh?

analyses.content: 两人商量后一致同意，既然Irene做了最多的实验，由她来写方法论部分（methodology section）是最合理的。
你可能会在听到最初的“材料和方法（materials and methods）”时没反应过来，雅思听力经常在随后确认时把它替换成“methodology”，要对这种同义替换保持高度敏感。

Well, let's divide up responsibilities, like who's responsible for each section. It only makes sense that Irene writes up all the materials and methods since she spent the most time with that. Oh, that's easy. Hey, didn't you just say we owe her one? Yeah, yeah, you're right. Irene can do the methodology section.
尽管中间有推诿，但Bill最后拍板决定，由Kim（she）负责结果部分（results section）才是最省事的。
你可能会因为Jen中间长篇大论质疑Kim的写作能力而跟丢答案，遇到这种来回推拉的对话，一定要耐心听到最后拍板的定论。

Do you wanna do the results? Not at all. I thought Kim would do that. Just because she is good at stats doesn't mean she'll be good at writing it up. And besides, you are the one good at copy editing. Well, all the same, I think it'll be easiest if she does the results section.
Jen用“我是唯一做完所有阅读的人”来暗示，随后Bill直接确认她肯定能写出最好的文献综述（literature review）。
你如果只等Jen自己报出任务名字可能会漏听，在这类匹配题中，答案往往是对方帮忙确认说出来的，要注意双方的接话配合。
Well, [chuckles] what part are you gonna do, Jen? Isn't that obvious? Since I'm the one who does all the reading. I'm sure you'll give us the best literature review, Jen.
Jen提议由Bill负责参考书目列表，Bill觉得有道理并最终亲口确认由自己负责参考文献（bibliography）。
你如果不知道录音里提到的“list of references”就是选项C“bibliography”的完美同义替换，就很容易在听到正确答案时犹疑不决而错过。

I guess that leaves the discussion section and the bibliography. Yeah. Can you make suggestions on these? Okay. But seriously, wouldn't it make more sense if you do the list of references? There are enough commas, capital letters, and parentheses to keep you happy in there. [chuckling] Yeah, you got a point. It sure does make sense that I do the bibliography.
两人发现只剩Linda没分到任务，于是顺理成章地决定把讨论部分（discussion section）丢给她去处理。
你可能会听到Bill抱怨这部分太重要并且会很长，以为他们要反悔，但这只是情绪宣泄，并没有改变把任务分配给Linda的最终决定。

I guess Linda could handle the discussion section, even if she hasn't been around much. Yeah, but isn't that, like, the most important section? Well, what else is she going to do? The whole paper. It'll serve her right. [chuckling] Then we'd all fail. Okay, but I think we all should start messaging her to make sure she gets busy. The discussion section can be long.
